biggest_catch: The payout is tiered and depends on the friend's activity: $50 for Advantage Plus Rewards status, $50 for $10,000+ deposits, $100 for $5,000+ personal loans — the friend must hit these within 90 days.
catches: Tiered payout: the referrer earns $50, $100, $150, or $200 depending on which qualifying Advantage Relationships the new member opens/maintains within 90 days.
Bonuses are paid in one sum no more than 45 days following the first 3 months of membership.
Both accounts must be in good standing at time of payment.
Bonus may be reported to IRS; taxes are the responsibility of the recipients.
Individuals may not refer themselves; offer may be discontinued at any time.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Advia Credit Union's official referral page (adviacu.org/refer-others) pays the referring member for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referring member earns $50 when the new member reaches Advantage Plus Rewards status, $50 when the new member accrues new aggregate deposits of $10,000+, and $100 when the new member obtains aggregate personal loans of $5,000+ — up to $200 per referral.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referring member submits their info on the Advantage Referral page, gets a referral link/certificate, and shares it via social media or email; the friend informs Advia of the referral when opening the account (or within 90 days).

c4.evidence: Timing: the referral incentive is placed into the referrer's Primary Share Savings within 45 days of the referred friend qualifying within their first 3 months of membership.

eligibility: Advia Credit Union members referring new members (not previously a member of Advia); the referred individual must qualify for membership.
notes: Advia Credit Union (MI/IL/OH). Tiered payout is explicit: $50/$100/$150/$200. Distinct from R0914's NM1000 signup bonus.
numeric_basis: Per-referral payout of $50.00 (Advantage Plus Rewards), +$50.00 ($10,000+ deposits), +$100.00 ($5,000+ personal loans) = up to $200.00.
payout_quote: For every friend or family member you refer to Advia, you each could earn up to $200. Referring member and those they refer ... will each earn stated payout(s) when new member opens and maintains one or more of the following qualifying Advantage Relationship(s) within ninety (90) days of new account opening: (1) $50 when the new member reaches Advantage Plus Rewards status; and/or (2) $50 when the new member accrues new aggregate deposits held of $10,000 or more; and/or (3) $100 when the new member obtains aggregate Personal Loans of $5,000 or more.
payout_value_note: Tiered: $50, $100, $150, or $200 per referral depending on the friend's qualifying relationships.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Bonus may be reported to IRS; any applicable taxes are the responsibility of the recipients.

s4.note: No stated annual referral count cap on the observed snippet.

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); offer subject to change and could be discontinued at any time.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: submit your info on the Advantage Referral page, share the link/certificate; the friend cites you at account opening.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: open a new member account relationship and within 90 days reach Advantage Plus Rewards status, accrue $10,000+ aggregate deposits, and/or obtain $5,000+ personal loans.

steps: Complete your info on Advia's Advantage Referral page and share your referral link/certificate.
Friend opens a new Advia membership and cites you as the referrer.
Friend qualifies within 90 days; your tiered bonus (up to $200) is deposited into your Primary Share Savings within 45 days.
timing: Referral incentive placed into the referrer's Primary Share Savings within 45 days of the referred friend qualifying within their first 3 months of membership.
